name: 10 Square Miles
description: Fun and fresh take on R&B, Soul, & Motown faves – fab harmonies and funky grooves that’ll make you want to get up and dance!

name: 14Strings! Filipino Rondalla
description: 14Strings! is a Filipino Rondalla based in Ithaca, NY. The ensemble is centered around 14-stringed plucked instruments: the banduria, the laud, and the octavina, as well as the guitar and bass. Our repertoire features a dynamic mix of Western classical, American songbook, Filipino kundiman, and OPM.

name: 18 Strings of Luv
description: “Three guitars and three voices with shimmering harmonies covering Beatles, Motown and other great music from the Golden Age of 60’s radio and beyond.”

name: 4word days
description: We are an original, creative and daring 5 piece rock band that plays varying styles of music. We have 2 recorded albums out there.

name: Adam Bauchner
description: Singer-songwriter blends the character-driven lyricism of Dawes, the minimalist vibe of Talking Heads, and the cynical bite of Elvis Costello. After several years rocking porchfest with the rock band Truth Decay, this year Adam brings you his originals in a more intimate solo set.

name: Aftermarket
description: Reinterpretations of classics and favorites old and new, tapping into the deeper vein that runs beneath the many different shades and styles of music we love and remember, music that is both familiar and new.

name: ah-bu-tah-ba-tah-tha-we
description: Sacred songs sung in the Karen language from members of the choir and children of the Ithaca Karen Baptist Church.

name: Alan Rose
description: The songwriter over the 12-string edge returns! Songs that’ll stick with you long after Porchfest fades. Solo acoustic, with a chance of random Restless Element cameos.

name: AlinaBlina
description: Singer/songwriter Alina sings with guitar, banjo. Covers and originals. Ephemeral voice. Mellow vibe. In collaboration with various other artists.

name: Amber Martin & The Fruit Stand
description: Amber Martin & The Fruit Stand is an indie folk band made up of 4 close friends. With beautiful harmonies, electric guitar, upright bass, and drums to sprinkle in a unique texture of their own.

name: Analog Breakdown
description: Ithaca-based Analog Breakdown is a five-piece string band that plays a range of folk genres including bluegrass, Celtic, and Americana.

name: Andrew Anderson Frankel
description: Folk rock mainly originals

name: Angelwood Celtic and Folk Duo
description: Mike Wood from the Shambles performs Celtic and Folk Songs on acoustic / electric guitar accompanied by Angela Gian-Cursio’s vocals and hand percussion.

name: Ariel Arbisser
description: Ithaca-based singer-songwriter Ariel Arbisser creates contemporary pop that’s somehow modern but nostalgic, dramatic but reflective with a sound reminiscent of Sara Bareilles, Adele, Alice Russell, and Laura Nyro.

name: Arlo C-B
description: Live loop-based musical amusement and light comedic interludes, along with acoustic instruments and synths. Mirthful soundscape creation and layered improvisation, along with visual art elements and some juggling.

name: Balkanic Eruption
description: Balkanic Eruption stirs up high-energy Balkan dance music with cello, violin, flute, and percussion. Their infectious odd-meter grooves will get your toes tapping, even if you can’t count that high. It’s folk music with flair, mischief and just enough modal chaos.

name: The Ballhogz
description: We are The Ballhogz, a team of Cornell social scientists who share a love for hard-hitting punk rock, the beautiful game, and democratizing access to youth sports. We are performing to raise funds for the construction of a covered five-a-side football pitch for the Indigenous community of Pozo Amarillo, Paraguay.

name: Barn Spiders
description: Seasoned musicians playing some of there favorites frome Trafic, The Beatles, Tom Petty and more.

name: Being Wolfe
description: Being Wolfe, becoming Wolfe: Jon and Laura Wolfe sing and play honest and timeless originals, songs for our present moment and for a patient future, accompanied by Nick J Wolfe on bass.

name: Benny and The Mix
description: Benny and the Mix is a Duo specializing in eclectic, upbeat covers as well as original songs.

name: Biba!
description: Biba brings the warmth and rhythm to Porchfest with classic bossa nova, samba, and jazz favorites. Grab a seat, relax, and enjoy timeless music that invites you to sway, smile, and sing along.

name: Bluegrass Alley
description: Seriously fun blend of original instrumentals, and traditional bluegrass standards, with soul stirring high lonesome harmonies

name: Bob Roberts Calamity
description: Like a jalapeño popper for your ears

name: Brain Dad
description: Moderately loud rock quartet of dads playing tunes from yesteryear ranging from Wierd Al to Neil Young to David Bowie.

name: The Brat Dondada
description: Focused on keeping the dancing floor ablaze, Dondada is setting the bar for nightlife DJs. Drawing inspirations from all different cultures across all genres, she is bringing the sounds of the 3rd world to the floor.

name: The Burning Men
description: Contemporary rock covers and originals. Rock the way you like it!

name: Capital Groove
description: pop/rock/funk band made up of young musicians from Albany, NY

name: Charlie Young
description: Charlie Young, a singer-guitarist with a voice that won’t quit, performs an eclectic selection of pop, folk, rock, swing, western, and country songs.

name: Chimes of Bayonets
description: Punk Rock from Ithaca, New York /////////////////// We like Unwound, Mission of Burma and Jehu

name: Chris Shrift & The Rock n Roll Boys
description: We are a five piece indie band with shades of country, shoegaze, garage rock, and jangle pop. Melty and twangy. We will be on tour promoting our new record and have been trying to get on porch fest for a couple years. Stoked it finally lined up!

name: Christmas Island Strangler
description: Christmas Island Strangler: Two young men who wanted to play music at Porchfest 2026 Synth-Insrumental

name: Christopher Beiswanger
description: Improvisational acoustic music

name: Cielle On Solid Ground
description: Cielle On Solid Ground is an all original female fronted global and folk infused indie rock band based in Ithaca NY. Bi-racial, bi-cultural power house vocalist Cielle will carry you through multiple genres supported by her talented band On Solid Ground. She weaves relatable lyrical stories of love, loss and the trials and tribulations of being a human. Every charismatic performance takes a hold of you leaving you with a sense that you’re not alone! Their infectious sound and energy pack venues throughout the NY Finger Lakes region and beyond. This up and coming band is garnering so much attention you don’t want to miss out!

name: Cobra Cadaver
description: Heavy Rock from Ithaca NY

name: Colwyn Gulliford
description: Solo guitar

name: Community Square Dance in the Street!!!
description: A great big joyful expression of community in these troubled times… that’s right, it’s a square dance, y’all! Tunes by Broke Holler; calling by Marc Faris. All dance taught from scratch — no experience necessary.

name: Cookie Coogan
description: Cookie Coogan performs a wide variety of swinging and soulful jazz, blues, pop, and original music. Joy guaranteed. Warning: might make you dance.

name: Cornell Campus Club Performance Group and Friends
description: Solo and duet performances on piano violin and voice of classical, jazz and Latin pieces. Low amplification of piano and voice

name: Cornell Gamelan Ensemble
description: The Cornell Gamelan Ensemble performs on the magnificent bronze gongs and metallophones of the Central Javanese Gamelan.

name: Cousins
description: A couple of non-biologically related, but nonetheless intimate cousins with some indie originals and silly covers.

name: Cuchulain
description: Party people of the world, unite!

name: Dad On Arrival
description: We play a fun mix of covers and originals: rock, pop and indie tunes that even our kids love, and a sense of humor for both the young and the fully groan.

name: Danny Speer and LMNOP
description: Speer is known for lyrical melodies, thoughtful songwriting, and an approachable vocal style that adapts across genres—from light jazz to folk-tinged country-pop.

name: The Dart Brothers
description: The Dart Brothers came together in 2015 in Ithaca, NY’s vibrant music scene. The lineup brings together Todd Edmonds, Dan Lashkoff on drums, Andy Russell on guitar, John North with his fiery electric guitar, Tamis Kaplan on sweet country fiddle, and Warren Bunn holding down the bass grooves—each member adding their own flavor to create something that’s equal parts heartland rock, upstate twang, and indie grit.

name: DJ MayMay
description: Kids DJ Performance geared towards young children and toddlers.

name: Djug Django
description: A perennial Ithaca favorite since 2002, 8 pc Djug Django plays Swing, Gypsy, Latin and Jug Band hits as well as many original favorites..always a treat

name: Dúo
description: Two guys and a drum track playing mostly original music and other tunes that we love.

name: Enochs Of Summer
description: we’re just a fun-loving group of music heads that happen to all be audio engineers and music producers. we all share a fondness for funk, disco, rock, punk, soul and electronic music. we are from NYC and play occasionally underground venues, like “The Good Room”. We don’t have any official recordings. After practice jam recordings have made it on to YouTube.

name: Evan Horne
description: Evan Horne is a cinematic-folk singer songwriter, composer, and visual artist from Oak Ridge, TN, now based in Ithaca, NY. His original music and live performance are known for their immersive, mesmerizing, and incandescent power that defy genre. Raised in East Tennessee with a singing minister father and artist mother, Evan was surrounded by and suffused with music and art throughout his childhood. The roots of music from his upbringing in TN resonate deeply through his own unique voice, emerging as both hauntingly timeless and fully his own.

name: Ever Stokes
description: Ever Stokes is an independent singer-songwriter whose songs have been described as “music for gourmets” (Theo Volk, Johnny’s Garden) and “a feast for the ears” (Dani Heyvaret, Rootstime). Their insightful and vivid lyrics pair with intricate finger style guitar to create music that spans the bluesy folk and alt-country genres, and at times reveals their roots in the classical tradition.

name: Fairwinds Recorder Ensemble
description: A diverse program of folk, Renaissance, Baroque and contemporary music written for recorders and classical guitar. Lovely music to begin your Porchfest day.

name: Fall Creek Brass Band
description: Fall Creek Brass Band is Ithaca’s favorite powerhouse brass group, blending New Orleans street music with funk, jazz, and pop. A regional favorite at GrassRoots, Rochester Jazz Festival, Ithaca Festival, and Porchfest, their mighty lineup of trumpets, trombones, saxophones, drums, and a big green sousaphone always draws a crowd and keeps everyone dancing!

name: Finger Lakes Fiddle Orchestra
description: Founded in 2019, Finger Lakes Fiddle Orchestra (FLFO) brings together beginner to expert level musicians from around upstate New York and northern Pennsylvania. The orchestra includes a range of instruments beyond fiddles/violins. We welcome stringed instruments such as violas, cellos, basses, guitars, banjos, mandolins, ukuleles, as well as other instruments such as accordions, flutes, and penny whistles. We are an adult orchestra and the music we play is suitable for intermediate players and advanced beginners. Learning by ear is encouraged, but sheet music will be available for download.

name: The FMs
description: The FMs are a bastion of queer music, exuding style through their politically-charged pop missives pioneering the genre of babygirl synth punk-rock. With a lineup of all queer, trans and nonbinary musicians from Ithaca, NY, they seek to undermine the patriarchy with ferocious love.

name: Fusebox
description: Music that booms and baps. Guitars that go chukka chukka. Keys that go pang. Lotsa vocal harmonies.

name: Get Off My Lawn
description: Geriatric punk band with a lot to say about a lot of stuff. Pure angst and fun!

name: Girl Unlearnèd
description: Sing/Songwriter – Songs about the continuing process of growing up and coming into oneself.

name: Ha’penny & Night Society
description: Ha’penny: a punk band. “The only band with the golden touch.” Night Society: underground, undergrass, and under the sky. The finest music experience west of east. With Will Kleinberg, Eli Porter, Arlo Jones-Rounds, and Hu “Grumm” Smith.

name: The Hand Me Downs
description: My music is folk and classical inspired, and it explores themes of resistance, love, complacency, community, and nature. Our sound is a mix of cello, guitar, ukulele, vocals, and hand drumming. We have a fun, chill, and genuine energy.

name: ICO Brass Quintet
description: Brass players from Ithaca Community Orchestra and Ageless Jazz Band, back after a 2-year hiatus. They play a wide range of music leaning on short, popular pieces for the Porchfest audience.

name: In-Laws and Outlaws
description: Blues jam music with guitar, violin, trumpet and harmonica. In-Laws and outlaws play a variety of blues based music. It’s a whole lot of fun !

name: Isaiah Berger
description: Growing up in the Ithaca NY music scene, Isaiah found himself greatly inspired by innovators of rock, alternative , and folk music. Through his work both solo, and as a member of Second Spring, he seeks to create meaningful music that resonates, and brings people together.

name: Ithaca Suzuki Music Education Cellos
description: There’s always room for Cello! Come and witness the future of classical music with our fabulous young musicians as they play favorites from the Suzuki cello repertoire as well as some other surprises.

name: Ithaca Suzuki Music Education Violins
description: ISME Violinists of all ages will perform Suzuki favorites as well as traditional fiddle tunes from around the world. Come and witness the future of classical music with our fabulous young musicians!

name: Ithaca Ukes & Hula Hut Dancers
description: Ukuleles AND Dancers. It doesn’t get better than this. Come on by!

name: Jackson Cavalier
description: Jackson Cavalier is an Americana one man band that’s been a full time recording and performing artist since 2013. He plays drums, guitar, harmonica, and sings all at once. He is based out of the FLX and has gone on numerous nationwide tours.

name: Jacob Turner
description: Acoustic Chicago and Delta Blues

name: JazzHappensBand
description: 7-piece traditional jazz band complete with banjo and clarinet

name: Jeremy & Beth
description: Bittersweet ballads and uplifting tunes. Jeremy & Beth have been singing on road trips and around campfires together since 2012. Come and hear a few of our favorite cover songs.

name: Johnny Dowd
description: American alternative country musician with roots in Fort Worth, Texas – transplanted into the heart of upstate New York. Johnny Dowd’s brand of country dances on the edge of grunge experimental and encourages listeners to push beyond their comfort zone and find the humor in any dark situation. From country-folk-rock to experimental synthesizer, he’ll keep you coming back for more with every thrumming beat.

name: jones et al.
description: Jazz quintet with eclectic grooves from r&b to bossa to swing, ft. Julia Picker (vox), Spencer Hadley (tpt), Matt Madden (guitar), Carter Knight (bass), & Michael Millenheft (drums)

name: Kaluja Co-Lusion!
description: A collaboration of two budding musicians and partners having fun playing some simple songs. There will be some singing, some guitar, some fiddle, and some smiling faces.

name: KingraHoff
description: KingraHoff’s unique sound is a blend of folk, rock, and Americana. Their original music is characterized by storytelling, harmonies, and music that will have you grooving. The band draws inspiration from artists like Shovels & Rope and Shakey Graves, The Decemberists, Elton John, and The Lumineers.

name: Kip Opperman
description: Veteran acoustic guitarist and songwriter who’ll be performing a mix of originals and classic covers from the 70’s though today. Kip has been performing in and around Ithaca since the late 70’s. Kip is also a founding member of the acoustic trio Tru Bleu.

name: Kitestring
description: Ithaca NY four-piece Kitestring blend rock, soul, and groove to lay down a tightly woven framework for their soaring hooks and sharp melodies. Intriguing songs lay siege to the emotional consciousness.

name: Knockout Rats
description: Rock/punky covers and mashups of songs from the 70’s, 80’s, 90’s, and today!

name: Kristin Bigness
description: Hook-laden indie pop/rock built on ethereal vocals, introspective lyrics, and folk-rooted storytelling. Influences include Jenny Lewis, Emily Haines, Waxahatchee, Maggie Rogers, and Portishead.

name: Liquid State Irish Session
description: Accoustic set- monthly Irish Music Session held at Liquid State.

name: Livers
description: Livers is a collaborative musical project that delivers a sound representing a fusion of folk genres. While they have taken inspiration primarily from the Old Time tradition, the final result remixes a traditional folk feel with hypnotizing trance inducing rhythms and haunting three-part harmonies. Livers is made up of Somer White on vocals and banjo, Marina Khananayev on banjo, guitar, and vocals, Julia Nelson on bodhrán and vocals, Myles Stokowski on fiddle, and Howard Kraskow on cello. Life is for LIVERS!

name: Lock & Key
description: A talented bunch of middle school kids playing songs from Coldplay, Shawn Mendes, Vance Joy, and more. Talia Lerner, a 14-year old girl, will also perform a few pop song covers.

name: Logs
description: I play high energy electronic music sets that incorporate live instruments.

name: Lome Marsupial
description: Friend of werewolves, banshees and nematodes. Original songwriting with rock and soundscape style. “Angels Don’t Stay at the Holiday Inn,” “It’s A-O-K to E.M.P.” “Bermuda Triangle: I Love You.” Late Night Hour feelings in the day light. Outcast music for the sophisticated Galavanters.

name: Luke Gustafson
description: Heavy melodic melancholy driven by electrified fingerstyle guitar. Inspired by John Fahey, Smiths, Angelo Badalamenti, Cars, The Sound, armchair existentialism, caffeine, flowers, cynicism, acceptance, etc

name: Lurlene
description: Lurlene is a folksy trio (sometimes duo) from Trumansburg featuring tight harmonies, unique instrumentation, and original songs by songwriters Laura Holmes, Christene Simone, and Lora Pendleton.

name: Marashino Olives
description: sax + ableton

name: Mark Maynard
description: Solo acoustic music from the front man from Scuba Jerry

name: Martha Armstrong
description: Songs from the heart. Eclectic balladeer singing folk, country, pop, jazz, classical. Accompanied by guitar.

name: Mary Bentley
description: Pop folk originals and covers

name: Material Objects & Friends
description: Cosmic indie rock with a special set of covers with friends.

name: Meandering Yardvarks
description: Sing-along and dance with this pedal-steel infused version of The Yardvarks. Quirky covers, tasty originals.

name: Metasequoia
description: High Energy & Big Sounds; Melodic driven grooves, ethereal jams, blasting brass and righteous harmonies.

name: Mighty Jet
description: Original intelligent blues. The Mighty Jet Band is a folky-blues assemble with a rock’n’roll heart

name: Mmmkay Ultra
description: Baroque surf and western-style indie three-piece. Songs inspired by or outright thieving from Gravity’s Rainbow. Costumes.

name: Motherwort
description: Motherwort is an Ithaca-based farm-grrrl folk-punk band known for driving rhythms, powerful three-part harmonies, and high-energy performances. A staple of the regional music scene, they’ve appeared at GrassRoots Festival, Elements Festival, Apple Harvest Festival, and many more, bringing their fierce musicianship and rebellious spirit to audiences wherever they play.

name: N.D Gold
description: N.D Gold is a singer/multi-instrumentalist based in Ithaca, USA. His music reflects his affinity for various types of sounds from all over the world, not conforming to just one genre. His sound has been described as “wonderfully complex and eerily beautiful.”

name: The Natcatchers
description: The Natcatchers is a six person jazz-influenced folk and rock band. Consisting of vocals, sax, keys, guitar, drums, and upright bass, The Natcatchers are sure to put a funky twist on new and classic tunes!

name: New Heart Worship Band
description: New Heart Church on Grandview Ave Ithaca Ny Praise and Worship band

name: Newman Brothers
description: Newman Brothers and Porchfest go together like peanut butter and jelly – don’t ask which is which. Enfield’s most infamous prop band. Rare Camping Trip! merch will be there to purchase!

name: Nikolai Ruskin
description: Old Time Banjo Songs

name: Noon Fifteen
description: Prog Soul band playing songs about love, vampires, politicians, and other monsters. Sounds like Lake Street Dive and Yes watching horror movies in your parents’ basement. “Unapologetically retro . . . unstoppably enthusiastic . . . without sacrificing intellectual curiosity or existential honesty.” ~Oldstyle Tales Press

name: Off the Rails
description: Off the Rails blends original & traditional blues and R&B creating a soulful & dynamic sound. Bernie’s leads wind us up, Garin’s bass & Roger’s drums hold down a solid rhythm, and Bev’s gutsy vocals bring it home.

name: Oliver Rose
description: Oliver Rose is a local poet, performer and artist. They consider themselves to be an “unprofessional” poet. Their writing involves moments of individual experience and go through little to no editing process in order to preserve the intention of the moment.

name: One heart drumming
description: Community open drum circle in the park.

name: Open Swim
description: 90s-inspired Alt Rock Bubblegrunge goodness

name: Owl Lantern
description: Solo acoustic guitar and banjo tunes, modern and old time

name: Parker Regan
description: Parker Regan is ready for her 3rd Porchfest! She is an acoustic set, and will be preforming some covers as well as an original song.

name: PaVaBu
description: Psychedelic Rock, Jazz and Reggae!

name: Penny Royal
description: Four piece Americana, country-folk, and blues

name: Peregrine
description: Peregrine is a four piece rock band that plays originals and some covers based in blues, classic rock, and many other genres.

name: Phil Way and Friends
description: Phil Way is a self-produced multi-instrumentalist in upstate NY, crafting bold, genre-blurring songs built from the ground up. From acoustic soul to fuzzed-out funk, his music is raw, melodic, original, and written with intention.

name: Pierce Walsh
description: Stars in the sky, feet on the earth, songs from my heart.

name: Plaster Men
description: Music you probably never heard but because it’s super catchy you think you may have but probably haven’t unless you been to one of our shows.

name: Porch Couch
description: Porch Couch is an indie/alt rock band from Ithaca NY with Brooklyn roots. Making sounds that are decent for every mood: Chill enough to sink in to a couch and vibe Lively enough to make you bop on your porch

name: Possum Holler
description: Old Time acoustic

name: Radio Saints
description: The Radio Saints are a post-punk-rock power trio. We write songs about heartbreak, social disorder, love, loss, and survival. Raw and unpredictable, the Saints say the unsayable and play the unplayable with rhyme, rhythm, and abandon.

name: Rain Tempos
description: Rain Tempos is an improvising trio from Ithaca, New York led by T.C. Owens on guitar and loops, with Keir Neuringer on saxophones and Matt Saccuccimorano on drums.

name: Raindrop Collector
description: Rock band from Ithaca College. Fueled by love for music; like the Power Rangers, man. Progressive and Emotional.

name: Real Quick
description: Catchy, garage pop punk

name: Red Eft Quartet
description: Jazz standards and original compositions.

name: Rev Ezra
description: Lyrically focused Americana – songs that dig at the truth of life’s toughest questions. Each performance is focused on genuine connection between performers and attendees.

name: Reveria
description: acoustic electric folk fusion ban

name: Richie Holtz and friends
description: Acoustic new and old folk music and some Beatles-era rock.

name: Rockvoices Ithaca
description: Rock Voices is a no-audition adult choir that sings ONLY rock music. Our mission is “healing ourselves and others through song.” Stop by our open rehearsals on 9/29, 10/6, & 10/13 at the First Unitarian Society of Ithaca to see if you’d like to sing with us!

name: The roly-poly puppies
description: laid back acoustic covers

name: Rosalina Maassen
description: Rosalina Maassen is a solo artist who expresses her feelings the only way she knows how – catchy pop rock songs!

name: Rowdy Rob & His Rockin’ Rangers
description: Rowdy Rob & His Rockin’ Rangers is a rock-blues-jazz fusion group based in Ithaca, NY.

name: The Rungs
description: The Rungs is an alternative pop/indie band formed by Mandy and Diwas Gurung. Their music features dreamy vocals, intricate guitars and an overall laid-back atmosphere.

name: Sarah Noell
description: Sarah Noell is a folk singer-songwriter accompanied by a full band for magic soaked moments (violin, flute, bass, accordion, drums)

name: Savage Cabbage and the Pickled Beats
description: A playful band serving up a fresh mix of pickled beats, garden-variety banter, and singalong favorites. Equal parts groove and goofiness, they’re here to turnip the volume, peas the crowd, and keep Ithaca celerybrating.

name: Savage Club of Ithaca
description: “TomFoolery” Celebrate the legacy of Tom Lehrer—mathematician, pianist, and master of musical satire. The Savage Club and friends bring his timeless, razor-sharp songs to life, tracing his lasting influence on generations of humorists. Join us to laugh, think, and hum along to some of the cleverest music ever written!

name: Scratched Vinyl
description: Original rock and covers from the band with more Porchfest organizers in it than any other.

name: Se Leigheas
description: We are an Irish session band playing and singing mostly Irish and Scottish music. Some of us have been together for over 10 years, while a few others joined the fun more recently.

name: Seasicker
description: Fuzzy noise rock

name: Secret Service Men
description: thrash punk band from Ithaca NY

name: SHAFTWAX
description: Original improvisational rock n roll music from Binghamton, NY. Soaring bliss to deep, dirty funk and everything in between.

name: Shuffle Bros
description: Shuffle Bros is Dan and Joe hopping to and fro on a porch full of rock instruments and trying to play them all at once with too few limbs. Originals. Covers. Lawn Ornaments.

name: SingTrece
description: SingTrece has extensive experience as a lead singer, performing with various bands across Pennsylvania, Ohio, and New York. She has worked with notable groups like the East Side Edition Blues Band, Cleveland All Star Soul Funk Band, and Best Kept Secret R&B Band.

name: Six Mile Craic
description: We’re an Irish session band based out of Ithaca NY, In happy Irish slang, “Craic” is a good time, a party, fun vibes between folks, and that’s what Six Mile Craic is all about. Growing out of Ithaca’s session scene, the six band members became a “musical pod” during the pandemic, and organically evolved from a session group into a tight ensemble. Time with Six Mile Craic will feature the sound of three (and sometimes four) fiddles, viola, whistles, uilleann pipes, bodhran, mandocello, and Bouzouki. Our rhythms and countermelodies enhance a wide ranging repertoire of Irish tunes, both traditional and modern, and we promise “good craic” and spirited music always!

name: Skylark Recorder Ensemble
description: We play a wide variety of easily recognizable early, classic, baroque and folk tunes

name: The Slip Kids
description: Nothing but The Who songs done on acoustic guitar and acoustic and upright bass

name: Sofrito
description: Sofrito plays high energy Afro- Latin dance music, featuring salsa, son cubano, bomba and plena. Their distinctive sound combines cuatro, tres, violin piano, bass, and a driving Latin percussion section.

name: Sonic Rust
description: Neil Young cover band

name: Space Duzzt
description: A textural post folk indie rock band from Ithaca.

name: Stars That Don’t Exist
description: Stars That Don’t Exist will take you on a journey through unexplored musical galaxies. A father and son band based right here in Ithaca featuring drums, tape recorders, keyboards, and MORE!!

name: Static Brian
description: philly emo/ posthardcore

name: Stone’s Throw Creek bluegrass band
description: Originals and standards in the style of bluegrass, country, and the Grateful Dead

name: Stranded With a Kiss
description: Original hard rock from Ithaca

name: Strong Maybe
description: Psychotic cartoon animal fever dream music.

name: Sue Tierney
description: Sue Tierney is the founder of the JoniMitchell.com Guitar and Piano Transcription Database. Sue plays with Joni Mitchell cover band Lauren and the Good Souls based in Rochester NY. Sue has researched Joni Mitchell’s guitar style including her use of over 50 different guitar tunings.

name: Sugar Beats
description: Mix of Americana, Indie Folk and Singer/Songwriter styles. A trio with acoustic guitar (Angela Rudert), electric guitar (Susan Terwilliger) and electric bass (David Bulatek), tasteful vocal harmonies and instrumental melodies woven throughout.

name: Súper Madame Band
description: indie rock, lyrical, latin-jazz fusion! 4 kids who met at Cornell and really love jamming together! Find us on instagram @suoermadamemusif

name: SWAMPFOOT
description: hardcore punk duo

name: Take Two
description: Dead/Feat/ Alt Country with tight harmonies

name: Taksim Ithaca
description: Middle Eastern Music and Dance

name: thurbs
description: magic ear electroacoustic krautrock duo

name: The Time Riders
description: The Time Riders deliver the rock music from the ’60s through the 2000s that everyone knows and loves. We bring these classics to life, uniting audiences of all ages for an unforgettable musical experience.

name: Timothy
description: Indie rock/dream pop music for daydreamers

name: timothy john weber
description: Solo guitar-and-vocal songs about Ithaca and generations and love and loss and life.

name: Tom Mank and Sera Smolen
description: Tom Mank, a US-based independent singer-songwriter for the past thirty-five years, has played in folk, blues, and bluegrass bands. Dr. Sera Jane Smolen is an active performer of many genres of music. She has performed four centuries of classical music. Rich DePaolo is an Ithaca NY-based singer-songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, producer-engineer. Kirsti Gholson is an independent singer-songwriter / vocal artist based in Woodstock, NY. Mank and Smolen have collaborated since 1993 and have toured Europe 15 times since 2005.

name: Trevor MacDonald
description: Trevor MacDonald is an original indie Americana songwriter and prolific recording artist whose music has taken him to hundreds of performances across the East Coast. Founder of Sunny Weather, he has released numerous albums as well as a solo record, blending restless songwriting with a lifelong foundation in indie, folk, and Americana.

name: Truth Decay & The Toe Beans
description: This performance will have members from the bands Truth Decay and Jeremy and The Toe Beans. We will be performing mostly original songs from both bands along with covers by Pink Floyd,Nirvana and Neil Young. Psychedelic alternative rock.

name: Truth Star & Friends
